thread:
infra-bot: :rotating_light: Alert detected: spike in routing error rate for smart-routing-policy 'sr-default' (5xxs from fallback decision). Severity: P1. Paging oncall.
Maya R.: I’m on it. seeing pager. checking vault for runbook link — SR routing runbook suggests checking decision-trace and route tags first. @Jamal can you pull decision logs? :eyes:
Jamal K.: pulling logs now. quick heads-up: dashboards show a surge at 03:07 UTC with many requests routed to v2-quantized and also to an old variant v1-ffnn in us-east. that’s suspicious, v1 is deprecated.
Priya S.: any customer 5xxs or degraded responses reported yet? Luis? :phone:
Luis (Support): got DM from AcmeCorp, they see weird style changes and ~30% request failures starting ~03:06. Their SLA calls this a major incident. They attached example request ids: rq_8a3f2a.. rq_8a3f9b..
Maya R.: Jamal — can you paste the decision log snippet for one of those request ids? also check if route_tag is being emitted.
Jamal K.: here’s an anonymized excerpt from decision logs for rq_8a3f9b:
```
time=2026-03-15T03:06:58Z request_id=rq_8a3f9b policy=sr-default decision=variant:v1-ffnn region=fallback-us-west->us-east route_id=null reason=capacity_mismatch
```
notice route_id=null and no route_tag. that explains why downstream prometheus metrics didn't attribute correctly.
Priya S.: route_id=null — that's the observability gap. The routing code should attach route tags before fallback. if route_tag missing, A/B metrics and canaries won't catch this.
Luis (Support): customers complaining that experiments toggled off are still getting v1 outputs. we pushed a canary disable last week, shouldn't be hitting v1.
Maya R.: hypothesis: fallback path uses a legacy code path that doesn't set route tags and falls back to v1 when quantized variants hit a kernel error. need to prevent region fallback loop. Jamal, can you check if we have a fallback loop (region->region) and whether decision_trace shows repeated attempts?
Jamal K.: searching. i see repeated attempts in a short window for same request id batch:
```
attempt=1 -> region=us-west decision=try-quantized-v3 -> error=kernel-oom
attempt=2 -> region=us-east decision=try-quantized-v3 -> error=compat-mismatch
attempt=3 -> region=us-west decision=v1-ffnn -> success
```
so it did bounce regions and then landed on v1. because route_tag absent, observability treated all as "unattributed fallback".
Priya S.: that explains the loop symptoms. we should immediately disable cross-region fallback for sr-default to stop oscillation. set policy override to local-region-only and pin variant to v3-quantized for the next 15m while we triage.
Maya R.: agree. executing mitigation now. applying temporary policy override. curl command used:
```
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/v1/policies/override \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $INCIDENT_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"policy":"sr-default","override":{"allow_cross_region":false,"pin_variant":"v3-quantized","ttl_seconds":900}}'
```
Maya R.: override applied. :white_check_mark: routing metrics show cross-region attempts dropped to 0 at 03:12 UTC. Luis — can you confirm AcmeCorp responses stabilizing?
Luis (Support): their errors dropped from 30%->4% in the next 3 minutes. still seeing slightly different style for some completions (likely due to quantized outputs) — customer on call is okay with interim fix.
Jamal K.: created issue INFR-8732 to track root cause: legacy fallback path skipping route tag emission and decision_trace verbosity was too low. adding logs now to emit route_tag and decision_trace at DEBUG on a short window.
Priya S.: action items: 1) patch fallback path to always attach route_tag & decision_trace (hotfix) 2) increase decision-trace verbosity for sr-default for next 2 hours 3) add an alert when route_id==null AND policy is sr-default 4) postmortem with customer impact and mitigation timeline.
Maya R.: starting handoff — @oncall-next you’re up for monitoring while we push hotfix. will DM the runbook and override token. please watch throughput and customer 5xxs for 30m.
oncall-next: acknowledged. I’ll watch alerts and keep this thread updated. will escalate if error rate climbs above 2% or if AcmeCorp reports new failures.
Jamal K.: deploying a small patch to ensure route_tag always set in fallback path. will push canary to a few nodes first. command:
```
git checkout fix/fallback-route-tag && ./deploy canary --service=router --nodes=3
```
Maya R.: thanks. also we should add a unit test that simulates kernel-oom to catch fallback behavior.
Luis (Support): opened customer incident INC-4521 and pasted the mitigation notes + timeline. AcmeCorp requested a follow-up postmortem. please include the logs where route_id was null.
Priya S.: logging improvement done — decision_trace now includes attempted_variants and final_variant and emits route_tag=sr-default:override for fallback overrides. will keep at DEBUG for 2 hours and then scale back.
Maya R.: summary for postmortem:
- impact: AcmeCorp ~30% errors and degraded outputs between 03:06-03:12 UTC
- root cause: legacy fallback path skipped route tag emission and allowed cross-region fallback to select deprecated v1 variant
- mitigation: temporary policy override (pinned v3-quantized, disabled cross-region fallback), hotfix to attach route_tag, increased decision_trace verbosity
- next steps: add unit test + add alert for route_id null occurrences + postmortem
Maya R.: closing pager handoff to @oncall-next. I’ll assemble the postmortem notes and schedule review. thanks all. :pray:
oncall-next: monitoring. will update if anything new."
